related.title: Groq LPU：靜態排程與資源衝突
related.titleEn: Groq LPU: static schedules and conflicts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：路徑不穿失效資源、無循環，延遲與可用容量分開報告。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Routes avoid failed resources and loops; latency and capacity are reported separately.
related.difference: 以資源占用與資料到達時間檢查排程，將可預測性與絕對速度分開。
related.differenceEn: Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定每跳延遲h的簡化路徑延遲L=nh；繞路增加跳數，即使資料仍可到達也增加延遲。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學網格原路徑6跳，每跳8 ns；故障繞行變為10跳，忽略排隊。 原延遲6×8=48 ns；此模型不含串列化與負載競爭。
單一共享傳送資源上的不相容區間不能重疊；下游開始時間不早於資料就緒。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 三筆傳送各4週期，依序占同一鏈路；最後一筆到達後需6週期計算。 完成時間=3×4+6=18週期；忽略其他可平行工作，不聲稱為產品時脈。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With fixed per-hop delay h, path latency L=nh; detours add latency despite preserved reachability. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching mesh:6 hops at 8 ns/hop; a fault detour takes10 hops, excluding queues. Baseline latency=6×8=48 ns, excluding serialization and contention.

Incompatible intervals cannot overlap on one transfer resource; consumers cannot start before data readiness. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Three transfers each occupy one link for 4 cycles; final data is followed by 6 compute cycles. Completion=3×4+6=18 cycles, excluding other parallel work and making no product-clock claim.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PCM 類比AI：ADC量化與漂移誤差預算
related.titleEn: PCM analog AI: ADC quantization and drift budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：路徑不穿失效資源、無循環，延遲與可用容量分開報告。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Routes avoid failed resources and loops; latency and capacity are reported separately.
related.difference: 建立ADC半LSB與漂移的最壞誤差界，說明增加ADC位元不能消除元件漂移。
related.differenceEn: Budget half-LSB and drift errors, showing why more ADC bits do not remove device drift.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 固定每跳延遲h的簡化路徑延遲L=nh；繞路增加跳數，即使資料仍可到達也增加延遲。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學網格原路徑6跳，每跳8 ns；故障繞行變為10跳，忽略排隊。 原延遲6×8=48 ns；此模型不含串列化與負載競爭。
教學均勻ADC步距Δ=FS/2^b，最近捨入界Δ/2；已知最壞偏差可保守相加。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 FS=1 V、b=8，類比漂移界1 mV；忽略失調、熱雜訊與飽和。 總界=1000/(2×2^8)+1=2.953125 mV。這是保守界，不是標準差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With fixed per-hop delay h, path latency L=nh; detours add latency despite preserved reachability. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching mesh:6 hops at 8 ns/hop; a fault detour takes10 hops, excluding queues. Baseline latency=6×8=48 ns, excluding serialization and contention.

Teaching uniform ADC spacing is FS/2^b, with nearest-rounding boundΔ/2; bounded worst-case biases add conservatively. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. FS=1 V, b=8, analog drift bound1 mV; ignore offset, thermal noise and saturation. Total bound=1000/(2×2^8)+1=2.953125 mV, a worst-case bound rather than standard deviation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
